paras: Most VW / SKODA doors all feature a red plastic reflector on the bottom of the door card, a safety feature to increase visibility when doors are open at night.

However, by replacing the standard reflectors with our bright courtesy door LED lights, it will increase visibility by ten-fold. Bright white LEDs illuminating to make sure other road-users are aware, and know what you're about to step onto.
hl: High end components for stable quality and reliability
